summary: OSR Holdings, Inc., a US-listed company (formerly Bellevue Life Sciences Acquisition Corp.), filed an 8-K reporting entry into an Asset Purchase Agreement dated May 27, 2026, with its indirect Swiss subsidiary Vaximm AG. OSR Holdings agrees to purchase all rights to the VXM01 cancer immunotherapy IP family for $30 million aggregate purchase price, payable upon first milestone (Phase 2 completion in GBM or PDAC) under a related License Agreement with BCM Europe AG. The transaction is a related-party asset transfer to make OSR Holdings the direct IP holder and beneficiary of future milestone/royalty payments. The board recommended the transaction; no advisors named. The price is deferred, contingent on future clinical milestones. Watch for VXM01 Phase 2 clinical data; risk-arb requires monitoring clinical success and license triggers.
